Name: Pretty Vanilla Alcohol
Author: deadduch
Description:
Pretty Vanilla Alcohol is a mod that aims to add new types of alcohols, without requiring the player to build new machines in order to craft them. PVA adds 8 new alcohols, which are all able to be made in the base Keg.

[size=5]Overview[/size]
PVA adds a total of 16 new items - 8 mashes, and 8 alcohols. After buying a crafting recipe from a store, you can craft a mash using farmable ingredients and place into a keg. The crafting recipes can be found in different shops, with 6 available from the start of the game. 3 in the Saloon, 3 from the Traveler. The last 2 can be found in shops not initially available at the start of the game.

PVA works with Automate. 

[size=5]Crafting Details[/size]
Once you have the crafting recipes, gather the materials needed to craft the mashes, then stick them into a keg to start the brewing process. The brewing time is catagorized into 4 categories: Short (Beer brew time) Medium (Juice Brew Time) Long (Wine Brew Time) and Very Long (Longer than Wine)

[list]
[*]Wheat Mash - 2 Wheat -  Medium
[*]Corn Mash - 2 Corn - Medium
[*]Cider Mash- 2 Apples - Long
[*]Amaranth Mash- 1 Amaranth - Short
[*]Rice Mash - 2 Rice - Very Long 
[*]Maple Mash - 1 Maple Syrup - Long
[*]Starch Mash - 2 Potatos - Medium
[*]Molassas Mash - 2 Sugar - Medium
[/list]
[size=5]Alcohols Added
[/size]Once the machines are done the processing, you can gather the following alcohols:

[list]
[*]Wheat Mash - Whiskey
[*]Corn Mash - Bourbon
[*]Cider Mash - Cider
[*]Amaranth Mash - Amaranth Beer 
[*]Rice Mash - Sake
[*]Maple Mash - Maple Wine
[*]Starch Mash - Vodka
[*]Molassas Mash - Rum
[/list]
[size=5]Aging[/size]
[size=2]After you have the alcohols, you can further age your alcohol into a cask. All alcohols can be placed into a cask to improve their quality and sell price![/size]
